entries.title: Thornwick East Gatepost
entries.text: Charred pine stakes ringed with notched iron spikes mark the market palisade. Bailiffs chalk unpaid Salt Tithe tallies on the gatebeam each dawn so drovers know who still owes coin.

entries.title: Sunken Ford Toll Marker
entries.text: An alder stake driven into river shingle bears three copper rings and an axe scar. Here the border watch once weighed salt barges before Grok'tar's raiders burned the ledger house.

entries.title: Fenwick Plank-Walk Sign
entries.text: A tarred oak board nailed crookedly above black peat water warns pickets to keep lanterns hooded past sunset, for mire wisps follow open flames across sunken turf ditches.

entries.title: Caged Beacon Pillar
entries.text: A rusted iron post holds a whale-oil cage stained blue with copperas soot. Keeper Soren etched tick-marks into the limestone base for every supply train lost to canyon fog.

entries.title: Greywood Mill Tally-Post
entries.text: Sawdust crusts the stone bollard beside the dry millrace. Iron crowbars wedge the oak paddle-wheel fast so Morvessa's bailiffs cannot float stolen hull-timber downstream.

entries.title: Border Mint Assay Stone
entries.text: Scorched granite slabs frame the collapsed coin-foundry where green vitrified slag pooled across cracked furnace bricks. Shaved silver dies lie buried beneath six years of cold soot.

entries.title: Craghorn Ley-Cairn Plinth
entries.text: Quartz-veined boulders stacked by First Compact surveyors hum faintly when sleet hits the ridge. Copper wire pinned beneath the capstone bleeds static harmlessly into damp turf.

entries.title: Alder Bridge Cutwater Plaque
entries.text: Chiseled into dressed granite above the central arch: Built to carry twelve-ton siege guns in lime and ox-blood mortar; behind the west pier sleep powder chambers for retreat.

entries.title: Ravenwatch Ossuary Lintel
entries.text: Cold condensation beads along the slate archway descending beneath Ravenwatch Keep. Lead probate tags dangle from copper nails inside the jamb, each stamped with a granary lien.

entries.title: Gallery Four Sluice Marker
entries.text: Bronze dwarven numerals cast beside the drainage wheel warn border magistrates to keep spring melt channels clear. Thick tallow seals show where tax-clerks bricked the tunnel shut.

entries.title: Outpost Stilt Ration-Board
entries.text: Bolted to a bleached leviathan rib above the alkali moat, brass tally-slides track boiled rainwater by the gill. Red dust cakes every crevice of the dry limestone stockade.

entries.title: Tilted Boundary Post
entries.text: An iron league-marker leans three degrees east as dissolving salt beds shift beneath the marsh. Sheep-skulls hung on willow stakes by Sand-Clan smugglers mark hidden dry footing.

entries.title: Corduroy Log Milepost
entries.text: Split pine trunks lashed with rawhide keep iron wagon wheels from sinking into sucking alkali mud. Wheel-ruts end abruptly where bogged Salt-Caravaneer convoys burned broken axles.

entries.title: Middle Spire Watch-Slate
entries.text: High above parallel canyon tracks, red sandstone chimneys retain furnace heat long after sunset. Chipped obsidian arrowheads wedged in the ledges betray decades of Sand-Clan ambushes.

entries.title: Four-Faced Milestone
entries.text: Imperial chiseling once measured leagues to Oakhaven and the southern coast. Someone hammered the southern arrows askew to lure northern relief columns straight into alkali sinkholes.

entries.title: Third Wardstone Plinth
entries.text: A towering monolith of milky quartz hums with jagged blue static. Fresh crimson blood-wards cut into its grounding grooves reverse the lattice and whip dust-squalls across the basin.

entries.title: Redrock Canopic Lintel
entries.text: Stranded limestone piers jut from dry salt-crusts where inland galleys once moored. Bitumen-sealed probate jars line the cellar niches beside copper-wired skeletons on eternal watch.

entries.title: Quarry Hoist Tally-Stone
entries.text: Stepped terraces of black ironstone plunge three hundred feet toward flooded third-dynasty bronze doors. Rusted winch-chains rattle whenever rising groundwater knocks against the sluice.

entries.title: Forked Causeway Marker
entries.text: Twin basalt bridges span the scree ravine beneath steaming iron boiler-pipes. Carved spear-notches along the parapet mark where two thousand vanguard levies stalled in freezing mist.

entries.title: Ironheart Sluice-Gate Seal
entries.text: Rusted bronze wheels lock the twin mountain aqueducts shut behind plates of salt-rimed iron. Through dry archways, warm desert dust whistles across reservoirs silted empty years ago.

entries.title: Whale-Oil Charter Brass Plate
entries.text: Riveted to the drydock sea-gate, tarnished brass letters record the Year -156 monopoly that funded Oakhaven's culverins. Pine pitch and boiled vinegar hang thick over the triage quays.

entries.title: Tanner's Gate Clearance Post
entries.text: Blackened timber beams lie stacked outside the curtain wall under a stamped eviction writ. Watch pickets torched every tenement within bowshot so raiders could find no wooden cover.

entries.title: Chalk Watchtower Orchard Stone
entries.text: Terraced apple trees drip thick violet sap onto gravel paths beneath a salt-pitted watchtower. Iron gallows-hooks buried among the roots bind coastal fog tight against crooked trunks.

entries.title: Riverlock Capstan Ordinance
entries.text: Bronze teeth gleam beneath slick kelp beside twin floodgate winches. Engraved rules order lock-crews to turn both capstans together lest tidal headwater tear timber catwalks loose.

entries.title: Lead-Lined Juggernaut Slate
entries.text: Bolted into sea-cliff granite above the northern pass, lead lettering names the seven iron bindings of an ancient construct. Arcing sparks dance along its copper rivets in wet salt air.

entries.title: Black Anchor-Rock Tide Post
entries.text: Iron rings pounded into dark reef basalt serve as high-water warning gauges for crossing scouts. When white surf tops the third ring, rip-currents swallow the gravel spit within minutes.

entries.title: Drowned Choir Sea-Arch
entries.text: Barnacles crust the carved stone ribs of a submerged gothic nave exposed only at low ebb. Saltwater drips down bronze frost-bells that chime whenever deep swells shake the foundations.

entries.title: Cliff-Watch Ration Tablet
entries.text: Scratch-marks on the slate parapet count forty-two days of Black Fleet blockade without a supply boat. Melted pewter sling-shot litters the embrasures above crashing grey surf.

entries.title: Culverin Elevation Marker
entries.text: Twelve-degree bronze wedges sit greased beside damp wool powder-covers on the chalk bluff. From here gunners drop solid iron shot straight onto enemy hulls clogging Harborwatch Bay.

entries.title: Great Prism Beacon Plinth
entries.text: Smoke from burning whale-oil slicks stains the granite steps of the outer mole lighthouse. Inside the tower, heat-cracked quartz lenses await recalibration to guide carracks seaward.

entries.title: Star-Iron Quenching Trough
entries.text: Geothermal floor-grates vent sulfur steam around basalt troughs filled with caldera brine. Stamped rules warn smiths that white-hot star-iron must be quenched in four heartbeats or snap.

entries.title: Defaced Imperial Milepost
entries.text: Black paving stones radiate dry furnace heat up through hobnailed boot-soles. Every royal crest along the highway has been chiseled out and stamped with Malrik's scorched wheel.

entries.title: West Crag Prism Stand
entries.text: Shattered bronze mirrors lie cold beside doused signal braziers on the volcanic ridge. Grounding wires bolted to a violet capacitor prism glow dull cherry-red before each static arc.

entries.title: Tower Four Sapper Marker
entries.text: Molten slag scars three basalt courses of the eastern curtain wall above the portal stairs. Brine barrels sit wedged beside the merlons where engineers fought to cool crumbling mortar.

entries.title: Lodestone Gorge Warning Post
entries.text: A copper plate bolted to oak warns soldiers against entering the thirty-pace gorge in unstrapped plate. Raw magnetic cliffs wrench steel blades sideways and jam crossbows mid-draw.

entries.title: Barbican Winch Anchor
entries.text: Thick iron portcullis chains run through twin basalt gatehouses overlooking Cinderforge Pit. Horn-blast signals carved in slate coordinate twin breaches before defenders shift ballistae.

entries.title: Sixty-Degree Traverse Stone
entries.text: Angled siege trenches cut cleanly into volcanic rock let repeating ballistae sweep every ditch without blind spots. Charred faggots stacked along revetments still reek of boiled pitch.

entries.title: Star-Bastion Dispatch Pillar
entries.text: Three converging causeways meet beneath jagged star-bastions guarding the magma moat. Dust plumes on every approach testify to Ember Court armies marching to reinforce the citadel.

entries.title: Plinth of Headless Kings
entries.text: Three decapitated basalt kings stand sentinel beside the Seventh Anchor Valve where sovereigns died for refusing caldera tithes. Steam hisses through bronze rims as the mountain groans.

entries.title: Seventh Iron Crown Hook
entries.text: Black marble columns display twelve chained border crowns beneath undying coal braziers. Below the seventh pillar waits an empty hook stamped with Thornwick's crest above the Cinder Throne.
